explanation: The AI response failed to identify the correct park with the largest number of non-native birds according to the NPSpecies data (identifying Zion as having 3, whereas Zion actually has 5 based on ground truth). Consequently, it did not include Chukar, Eurasian Collared-Dove, or Rock Pigeon, and incorrectly included Ring-necked Pheasant.
